descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S28 Preston grades the AI-check outputs against EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK.md (TFA-94229 AC 2), including level choice

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T2 TC-18 AI checks pass per ground rule 3.2, graded against Vikram's EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK.md (attached to TFA-94229 on 2026-10-13, the latest decision). … (TFA-94229 AC 2 (EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK.md); UAT 3.2; UAT 3.4) — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress; TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U12 AI Check 1: lab results alone never earn 'independent interpretation'. At least 10 independent scenarios (5 Hospital, 5 Nursing Home), pass at 9/10 or better, every failure quoted. … (UAT TC-18 AI Check 1; UAT 3.2; TFA-92596 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U13 AI Check 2: every Problem, Data and Risk element quotes a sentence from the note or is left out: no supplied diagnoses, no 'intensive monitoring for toxicity' from a trough level, no 'critically ill' … (UAT TC-18 AI Check 2; UAT 3.2; UAT 3.4; TFA-92596 AC 3; TFA-92596 AC 4; TFA-94229 R8) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr; TFA-94229 in progress

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given The quoted outputs of S13 (AI Check 1, 10 cells) and S15 (AI Check 2, 10 cells), the S17 levelOrder and code-histogram records, and EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK (1).md as attached to TFA-94229 on 2026-10-13

When First map each billing criterion in the framework to a matrix check or to a grading item (T2.frameworkMapping); then Preston grades every output against the framework, per mode

Then Each AI check passes at >= 9/10 per ground rule 3.2 as graded against the framework, every failure quoted; where the framework's level table or element definitions differ from Q2 / oracleRules, the framework's verdict stands and the pre-screen is corrected

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Preston's grade per output against EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK.md, written next to the pre-screen verdict; disagreements between the two are listed. Level choice (Run 7: 99232 on 19 of 21 hospital follow-ups) is graded here from S17's levelOrder and histogram if Q13 puts it in TC-18's scope, and recorded otherwise. …

Where it ran: dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S28 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-18.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: DOC · Document check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
